title: Stones floated in on reed boats and the pyramid site flooded

tellings.quote: built Reed boats uhhuh they actually harvested the stone uhhuh up the Nile

plain: The Egyptian pyramid builders are said to have built reed boats, cut stone up the Nile and floated it down, with the Giza site flooded so the blocks could be brought in by water. Joe McMoneagle, a remote viewer, someone who says he can see distant places and times with his mind, tells Michels this, crediting his book The Ultimate Time Machine. If true, it would explain how the huge blocks were moved without any mystery machinery.
